MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

2. Solve for x: x + 7 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 9
   C. 7
   D. 15

3. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 32

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 144

5. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

6. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 1
   D. 7

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 30
   C. 60
   D. 19

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 44
   C. 22
   D. 15

9. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 13

10. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 100
   C. 11
   D. 10

11. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

12. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 33

13. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

14. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 37

15. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

16. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

17. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 90

18. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

19. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

20. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 17
   C. 7
   D. 19

21. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 31

22. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 21
   C. 20
   D. 9

23. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

24. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
